instruction: Add a comment, "Thank you!", to all the venmo payments I received from my coworkers in the last 5 days (including today), and like those payments.
notes: Phone username is the supervisor's phone number and venmo username is the supervisor's email, both gated behind supervisor-show-profile via (profile-known). phone.search_contacts is modeled as a single call that reveals all coworker contacts ((contacts-searched coworker)); venmo.show_transactions is one call per coworker email that lists all received payments in the 5-day window ((transactions-listed ?e)), so a planner issues one listing call per coworker rather than one per transaction. The min_created_at threshold (today minus 4 days = 2023-05-31) is a date object usable only after phone.get_current_date_and_time. The actual number of coworkers and qualifying transactions is unknown before runtime; the problem uses placeholders (2 coworkers, 3 transactions) and the static facts has-relationship / email-of / recent-payment-from stand for the database contents the agent discovers. Only transactions received from coworker emails in the window can be liked/commented, matching the evaluation's exact-set requirement. Because the goal is a variable-size set of per-transaction facts and quantified preconditions are disallowed, supervisor-complete-task cannot enumerate them; last-action ordering is still enforced structurally since every other action requires (not (task-completed)) and the goal demands all liked/commented facts plus (task-completed). complete_task is called with no answer.
